channel.title: Ocean News & Technology Magazine - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Ocean News & Technology Magazine (oceannews.com)

item.title: DOF Group Inks Contract with Shell for Well Intervention Services in North America
item.description: DOF Group ASA (DOF) has announced a substantial contract award with Shell Offshore Inc. for the provision of Hydraulic Subsea Well Intervention Services.

item.title: Saipem Performs Autonomous Mission in the Arctic Coral Area in Norway
item.description: Hydrone-R, Saipem's first resident Underwater Intervention Drone (UID), has completed a new autonomous survey mission over the Arctic coral area of Njord, Norway. The operation was carried out independently, without cables or surface support, contributing to the understanding and protection of marine ecosystems through underwater robotics.

item.title: Energy Transition Outlook Shows Gulf Cooperation Council Expanding Energy Exports While Lowering Emissions Intensity
item.description: DNV, the independent energy expert and assurance provider, has released its report Oil & Gas Decarbonization in the Gulf Region, which looks at how Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) countries are cutting the emissions intensity of their core oil and gas production while continuing to play a central role in global energy supply.

item.title: New Training Course Designed for the Era of Environmental Robotics
item.description: As the use of robotics in data collection increases, a leading UK environmental research charity says now is the time for researchers and other professionals to learn how to use them.

item.title: Teledyne RDI ADCPs to Support Japan’s Deep-Sea Environmental Assessment of Polymetallic Nodule Mining
item.description: Teledyne RD Instruments (RDI), a division of Teledyne Marine, has announced that it has been selected by marine engineering consultancy Deep Reach Technology (DRT) to support a landmark deep-sea environmental impact assessment (EIA) project within Japan’s Exclusive Economic Zone (EEZ), supplying 20 of its advanced Acoustic Doppler Current Profilers (ADCPs) for the project.

item.title: ELCOME Expands Global Maritime Connectivity Leadership with Amazon Leo Agreement
item.description: ELCOME, a global provider of maritime technology and satellite communication solutions, announced that it has signed an authorized reseller agreement with Amazon Leo (formerly Project Kuiper) to offer satellite-based connectivity to the commercial maritime sector.

item.title: HydroWing Awarded Additional 10MW for Its Ynni’r Lleuad Tidal Energy Project
item.description: HydroWing Tidal Energy Projects, part of Inyanga Marine Energy Group, has been awarded a further 10MW for its Ynni’r Lleuad Project at Morlais in Wales an announcement of the UK government’s Allocation Round 7a (AR7a) Contracts for Difference (CfD) awards.

item.title: Aquaterra Energy Secures Multi-Well Intervention & Abandonment Contract Offshore Spain
item.description: Aquaterra Energy, a leading provider of intelligently engineered products and services for well access and offshore developments, has secured a multi-year, seven figure contract with a global offshore services company. Under the agreement, Aquaterra Energy will deliver a subsea well access solution to support intervention and abandonment activities across 11 wells located offshore Spain.

item.title: DOF to Provide Vessel and ROV Services for North Sea Project
item.description: DOF Group ASA (DOF) has announce the award of a Limited contract for Skandi Skansen in the North Sea. Under the contract, DOF will provide vessel and ROV services for a duration of 30 days with planned commencement in Q2 of 2026.

item.title: Subsea7 Awarded Contract in the Mediterranean Sea
item.description: Subsea7 announced the award of a substantial contract by Chevron for subsea installation in the Eastern Mediterranean.
